title: Chú mèo ngủ
about: Round 33, ke-chuyen-gan ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác album mới, theo phong cách ambient và dễ ngủ"), for a new album, Những giấc mơ nhỏ: the sleeping cat, a small lullaby in C major in 3/4 at 62 bpm, warmer with 4 dB more of the Rhodes under the piano. Its motif turns on a note of the chord (E-G-E, C-E-C) and steps down; the middle in A minor; the violas' thin line under it. Written to sleep to, on the sound the user settled on (ke-chuyen-gan: the piano near, a wide hall, a soft echo): its tune moves by step and stays low, its sentences come back with small changes (each middle section 16 bars, a sentence and its variation), the left hand rocks in eighths through most of it, the climax stays low. An original tune.
